div.div: 6 تَشَاقَّا , said of two adversaries, or litigants, as also ↓ اِشْتَقَّا , They wrangled, quarrelled, or contended, each with the other, (M, TA,) and took to the right and left in contention; (TA;) فِى الشَّىْءِ [in respect of the thing]. (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
